articles.title: AI exposed a massive flaw in top crypto network and experts warn banks could be next
articles.snippet: After an AI model helped uncover a four-year-old flaw in Zcash, security researchers warn that similar bugs may be hiding across crypto and traditional financial systems.

articles.title: U.S. House tax committee weighs crypto bills, including relief for small transactions
articles.snippet: Seven draft bills are being circulated by the House Ways and Means Committee ahead of a hearing next week, including proposals to ease small-gain, mining and staking burdens.

articles.title: Bitcoin most oversold since 2020 crash: Can BTC rebound to $70K next?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s latest oversold RSI mirrors 2020 and February 2026 setups that preceded 50% and 30% rebounds, putting $70K back in focus.

articles.title: ETH falls to 13-month low on Zcash bug news and Bitcoin drop to sub-$60K: Is $1.4K next?
articles.snippet: ETH price crashed below $1,600 as a vulnerability in Zcash emerged and Bitcoin sold off below $60,000 for the first time in months.

articles.title: Bitcoin fell 21% after Strategy’s debt buyback news: Is Terra Luna-style doom loop next?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price collapsed as Strategy faced tighter liquidity conditions and paused its BTC buying. Is it time to jump ship or buy the dip?
